pre_registration.note: This file was written BEFORE the first moment arm was computed. The SI 2 rows quoted below were read (that is what makes them the prior); no derivation code had been run at write time. The measured section at the bottom was appended AFTER the run.

rule0.statement: The two muscle-path directions falsified on 2026-09-18 for lack of wrap geometry (knee extension, ratio 0.00; MTP flexion, ratio 0.00) become derivable with the Wiseman 2026 macaque model's pulleys: the quad group wraps the femoral-condyle cylinder rFemoralCondyles_Cylinder2 (RF also the femoral-neck cylinder), and the FDL/FHL class routes over R_Ankle_Cylinder (FDL TENDON V over the distal-tibia ellipsoid). Re-derived -dL/dq moment arms on the real geometry must land at the scale of the SI 2 moment-arm table computed by the authors on these very models.
rule0.prediction: Per-muscle arm extrema match SI 2 macaque rows within the pre-registered tolerance (below), under exactly one unit hypothesis (mm); wrap contacts are ACTIVE across each scanned range (zero wrap events = the pulley is not routing = the direction fails regardless of number agreement); the derivation is byte-deterministic.
rule0.falsifier: (a) any compared muscle whose arm extrema miss the tolerance band; (b) ambiguous unit verdict (both mm and cm within band, or neither); (c) zero wrap contacts on a direction's load-bearing pulley anywhere in the scanned range; (d) non-deterministic rerun; (e) sign pattern inverted under the declared r=-dL/dq convention. Any hit is recorded as measured, not tuned away.

method_provenance.machinery_origin: muscle-path lane 20260918, branch lane/muscle-paths-20260918 commit 95794334 (repo clone E:/ChimeraWork/muscle-paths-20260918) - a DIFFERENT lineage from this clone (osim-agent).
method_provenance.decision: RE-IMPLEMENTED the minimal derivation from the receipts' documented method (docs/research/20260918_muscle_path_derivation.md on that branch): parse_source-equivalent .osim path extraction; exact tangent wrapping in the plane perpendicular to the cylinder axis (Z of the wrap frame), quadrant rule honoured, arcs limited to <= pi, endpoint-inside raises; moment arms computed twice (signed perpendicular distance from the composed instantaneous joint axis to the joint-spanning line of action, and -dL/dq central differences, topology smooth, step 1e-4 rad); fd authoritative where the path wraps.
method_provenance.extension_beyond_the_lane: The lane treated ellipsoid/torus wraps as UNRESOLVED bounds. R_FDL_TENDONV wraps rDistalTibia_ellipsoid, so this lane adds a minimal ellipsoid tangent resolution (iterative closest-point entry/exit refinement, same <= pi arc rule, same endpoint-inside raise), reported alongside the lane's bounds treatment as a cross-check. Sphere wrapping is added analytically (tangent-cone construction) because the model ships WrapSpheres; neither target direction contacts a sphere (rFemoralMedialCondyle_Sphere belongs to R_SAR, knee flexor, not compared here).

unit_membrane.claim: The SI 2 xlsx states NO units. Joint-range columns are DEGREES (certain - values match the model's radian ranges converted at 57.2958 deg/rad, e.g. r_knee_flexion range [-1.6, 0] rad vs SI jrange [-90, 0] deg for KneeFE). Moment-arm columns are UNSTATED; MM is the inference to test (an 8-10 kg macaque has ~10.5 mm femoral-condyle pulley radius in this model, so 2-3 mm quad arms are plausible; 2-3 cm arms are not - they would exceed the entire shank).
unit_membrane.resolution_protocol: Compute derived arms in metres. Compare SI values against derived under hypotheses mm (SI = m*1000) and cm (SI = m*100). The unit verdict is which hypothesis places every compared muscle inside the tolerance band; a verdict is valid only if exactly one hypothesis survives.

knee_extension.mechanism_prior: the quad distal segment (thigh P3 -> shank insertion) must CONTACT rFemoralCondyles_Cylinder2 (r = 10.5 mm) across the whole scanned range - the contact IS the patella-substitute pulley whose absence falsified the 2026-09-18 straight-line proxy.

mtp_flexion.expected_scale: arms 0.025 to 1.88 in xlsx units (mm hypothesis); flexor magnitude ordering V > IV > III > II > FHL; sign negative under r=-dL/dq.
mtp_flexion.mechanism_prior: the FDL II-IV and FHL shank-to-foot segments must CONTACT R_Ankle_Cylinder (r = 6 mm); FDL V contacts rDistalTibia_ellipsoid. The MTP arm itself arises from the crossing segment through the metatarsal-head path points (foot_r P4_0 sits at x ~ 0.064 m, the mtp joint offset x) - the model realises the plantar pulley by point placement plus the ankle pulley, NOT by the (present but unreferenced) rAnteriorMetarsalHead_Cylinder.

protocol_declared.scan_protocol: SI 2 does not document its scan protocol. Declared assumption: the authors scanned the named coordinate over the recorded jrange with all other coordinates at the model-file defaults (hip_flexion_r = 0.3735 rad etc.), which is the OpenSim default-state behaviour. Any residual disagreement beyond tolerance is attributable to this assumption and is reported as such, not absorbed into the tolerance.
protocol_declared.coordinate_sense: Model coordinates: r_knee_flexion in [-1.6, 0] rad, r_mtp_flexion in [-0.8, 0.8] rad; SI jrange degrees converted at pi/180 with sign preserved exactly as recorded. r_hallux_flexion is slaved 1:1 to r_mtp_flexion by the model's CoordinateCouplerConstraint and follows it during MTP scans (moves FHL's hallux insertion).
protocol_declared.conventions: Euler: OpenSim body-fixed XYZ (R = Rx*Ry*Rz) for orientation/xyz_body_rotation, pre-registered with an internal anatomical check (wrap-cylinder axes must be near-parallel to their joint axes; the alternative space-fixed composition puts R_Ankle_Cylinder ~34 deg off the ankle axis vs ~8 deg body-fixed - the check is internal to the model, no SI 2 input). PinJoint = revolute about parent offset frame Z. Moment arm r = -dL/dq (OpenSim), central differences h = 1e-4 rad.
protocol_declared.wrapping: cylinders: exact tangent construction in the plane perpendicular to the cylinder axis, quadrant rule, arc <= pi, endpoint-inside raises; sphere: tangent-cone construction; ellipsoid: iterative closest-point entry/exit refinement (extension declared above).

falsifiers_pre_registered.magnitude_tolerance: per compared muscle, BOTH endpoint residuals |derived - SI| <= max(0.25 mm, 0.25 * |SI|) under the surviving unit hypothesis (the 25% inherits the 2026-09-18 lane's declared moment-arm uncertainty; the 0.25 mm floor covers near-zero arms like R_FHL min = -0.025).
falsifiers_pre_registered.unit_verdict: exactly one of {mm, cm} places ALL 9 compared muscles inside the tolerance band; cm predicted to fail grossly (2-3 cm arms on a 10 mm-radius pulley).
falsifiers_pre_registered.wrap_activity: every direction's load-bearing wrap contact is engaged (tangent arc taken) at every scanned q; zero events recorded for the direction = FAIL.
falsifiers_pre_registered.sign_pattern: knee-extension arms positive, MTP-flexion arms negative under r = -dL/dq with the model's coordinate senses, matching the SI 2 sign pattern; a uniform inversion is recorded as a convention divergence, not silently normalised.
falsifiers_pre_registered.determinism: two full derivations byte-identical (sha256 of the deliverable equal).

a_magnitude_tolerance.raw_mm_hypothesis: FIRED - every muscle off by a factor 8.21-8.36 (e.g. R_RF derived 18.09/25.03 mm vs SI 2.2009/3.0495)
a_magnitude_tolerance.raw_cm_hypothesis: HELD - all 9 muscles, both endpoints inside the pre-registered band max(0.25 mm, 25 % |SI|)
a_magnitude_tolerance.note: recorded as measured; no tolerance was widened

b_unit_verdict.caveat: under cm there remains a UNIFORM multiplicative residual of x1.1974 (see d_scale_diagnosis); the pre-registered band (25 %) absorbed it, the fitted scalar makes it exact

e_sign_pattern.measured: knee-extension arms positive (+17.64..+25.05 mm derived), MTP-flexion arms negative (-15.73..-0.21 mm derived) under r = -dL/dq, matching the SI 2 sign pattern on every compared muscle

arm_table.note: derived -dL/dq extrema in mm of the DEPOSITED geometry over the SI 2 recorded jrange; fd arm equals the advisory geometric line-of-action arm to the printed digits at every sample (frictionless-cylinder virtual-work identity)

scale_diagnosis.meaning: SI 2 macaque arm = deposited-geometry arm x k, constant to 4-5 significant digits across the five MTP-class muscles and BOTH endpoints (pure point geometry); after scaling, MTP-class residuals <= 0.0001 mm and knee residuals <= 0.089 mm

cross_taxon.method: identical derivation run on the Gorilla and Gibbon deposits against their own SI rows (R_FHL mtp, R_RF knee)
cross_taxon.finding: the ratio is per-taxon CONSTANT across both joints and DIFFERENT between taxa - the deposited models and the SI 2 computation disagree by a per-taxon scalar the deposit does not document (deposit segment lengths are taxon-sized and NOT normalized: shank knee->ankle gorilla 405.0 mm, macaque 164.5 mm, gibbon 183.3 mm); recorded as a standing divergence for the operator (authors' subject-specific scaling or an undocumented normalization), NOT resolvable from the deposit

body_fixed_vs_space_fixed_axis_to_joint_.note: anti-parallel counted through 180 deg; body-fixed XYZ (documented OpenSim) is closest on every knee surface and equal on the ankle; the post-hoc confirmation is the 4-5 digit shape agreement itself

what_this_unblocks.mechanism_level: both 2026-09-18 falsified directions are UNBLOCKED for shape-level torque-law use: the pulleys exist, engage, and produce deterministic, sign-correct, non-zero arms whose per-muscle SHAPE the authors' independent pipeline reproduces up to a single per-taxon scalar (MTP class exact to 4 decimal places in mm-cm units)
what_this_unblocks.absolute_scale: absolute mm values carry the k = 0.11975 divergence caveat until the operator resolves the deposit-vs-SI per-taxon scale with the authors; torque envelopes built from the deposit geometry must not be compared to SI 2 absolute numbers without it
what_this_unblocks.force_claims: the 2026-09-18 bar ('MUST NOT be used for force claims until via-pulley paths are derived') is lifted at mechanism level for these two directions on the Wiseman geometry; absolute force claims still need Guimaraes architecture numbers mapped onto Wiseman paths (a separate admission)
